notes.title: Early Access Update 4 Patch 1
notes.content:
We temporarily removed the tutorial for the game will not work.

The following is a brief tutorial description：
1.Training Area is where you can experience all the weapons and their tutorials. You can open them through the UI that can be opened by clicking Menu button on you controller.
2.Equipment area can make you to equip and custom weapons.
3.You can take the gun from Weapons Wall, then put it in Weapon Box on your right side.The weapons in the box will be set in the zombie scene.
4.By completing different goals you can unlock different weapons and weapon accessories.
5.You can move to different areas through the UI on you hand.

notes.content:

AK47: The first time to complete the level
Bow: Kill 20 zombies
Holographic Weapon Sight: Eliminate the second wave of zombies
Grenade: Eliminate the fourth wave of zombies and a Boss zombie

SPAS-12: Eliminate the second wave of zombies

Level 4 CDC:
Second Beretta 92: Headshot 20 zombies
Laser flashlight sight: Eliminate the fourth wave of zombies and a Boss zombie

notes.title: Early Access Update 4 is Live!
notes.content:
Additions:
Added New Level: CDC
Added New Scene: Weapon Room
Added New Weapon: Gatlin, Kukri, Grenade
Added New Weapon Accessories: Flashlight, Knife, Holographic Weapons Sight, Sight
Added Weapon Training: Now you can try most of weapons on Training Area in Weapon Room
Added New Zombie Performance: The zombie's arms and legs can be interrupted
Added New Newer Tutorial: Guide the player to understand the basic operations and the various areas of Weapon Room

Changes:
Now you can take any main weapon and any vice weapon into the zombie scene Through setting these weapons in Weapon Box.
Rebuild the way of weapon and ammo refreshing. two guns in Weapon Box will be set in the zombie scene, the other weapons that have been unlocked will also be set in the zombie Scene at the beginning of level. the ammo refresh when each wave of zombies start.
Weapon tutorial is placed on Training Area in Weapon Room where you can try all weapon tutorials
Adjusted the position of the bow sight
Reduced the recoil of Ak47 when two hands manipulate it.
Improved the some other performance of weapons details.

Fixed:
Sometimes Beretta 92 can not reload
Sometimes Colt Python unload bullets without opening the cylinder
Sometimes zombies pass through obstacles that aren’t broken
Repair the hand gesture when picking cola

notes.title: Early Access Update 3 is Live!
notes.content:
Early Access Update 3 is Live!
1.Improve the real of weapon operation:
M92
It drop a bullet after pulling manually the slide.
If there is a bullet in the gun, you can shoot once after uploading the magazine.
If there is not bullet in the gun, the slide can not manually pull back.
AK47
It drop a bullet after pulling manually the slide.
If there is a bullet in the gun, you can shoot once after uploading the magazine.
Every time you reload the magazine, if there is no bullet in the gun, you need to manually pull the bolt once.
Spas12
The shell or the bullet can droped correctly after pulling the slide.
If the dropping bullets are complete, they can be refilled into the gun.

2.Fixed bugs:
Sometimes you can not reload the magazine After loading magazine of M92.
Sometimes the hand suddenly can not pick up items in the process of loading the bullet of Spas12. 
There are not bullet marks when bullets hit the target in the StartGame scene and tutorial scene.
